title: The Panic Button Workout
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: male storyteller, mid-30s, neat beard, smart casual shirt

Rohan.look: young man, late 20s, fair skin, messy dark hair, wide eyes, wears old grey track pants and a slightly stretched blue t-shirt, determined but out of his element

Priya.look: young woman, late 20s, light wheatish skin, long wavy dark-brown hair, small silver earrings, elegant pastel pink gym outfit, calm and focused

Gym Bro.look: muscular man, early 30s, bald head, prominent bicep tattoo, black tank top, intense but kind face

scenes.image: Rohan, eyes wide with determination, lifting an absurdly heavy dumbbell, face contorted with effort, sweat dripping. The gym is a bit blurry in the background. Close up on his straining face.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: First day at gym? Maine pura mahaul hila diya!
scenes.say: फर्स्ट डे ऐट जिम? मैंने पूरा माहौल हिला दिया!

scenes.image: Rohan, looking self-conscious but trying to act confident, entering a modern, bustling gym. Priya is doing lunges gracefully in the background.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rohan ka aaj pehla gym day tha.
scenes.say: रोहन का आज पहला जिम डे था।

scenes.image: Rohan sees Priya, his eyes widen slightly, a hopeful smile. Priya is wiping sweat from her brow, looking fit and serene.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Usne dekha Priya kitni fit thi.
scenes.say: उसने देखा प्रिया कितनी फिट थी।

scenes.image: Rohan at the weight rack, looking at the heaviest dumbbells with a grimace, then back at Priya. He takes a deep, determined breath.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Usse impress karna tha. Big plan!
scenes.say: उसे इम्प्रैस करना था। बिग प्लान!

scenes.image: Rohan struggles to pick up a huge dumbbell from the rack, his face red with effort and exertion. Priya is visible in the background, unfazed, still exercising.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Priya ko impress karne, sabse heavy weight uthane ka socha.
scenes.say: प्रिया को इम्प्रैस करने, सबसे हेवी वेट उठाने का सोचा।

scenes.image: Close up on Rohan's face, straining, veins popping slightly on his neck. His old t-shirt is stretched tightly across his shoulders.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Uff! Yeh toh bohot zyada tha!
scenes.say: उफ़! ये तो बहुत ज़्यादा था!

scenes.image: Priya looks over, a slight amused smile forming on her lips as she watches Rohan struggle, shaking his arms.
scenes.speaker: Priya

scenes.image: Rohan, gritting his teeth, shaking slightly, making a final push to lift the dumbbell. His hand is dangerously close to his track pant pocket.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Bas, ek aur push! Ho jayega!
scenes.say: बस, एक और पुश! हो जाएगा!

scenes.image: Suddenly, a loud, piercing car alarm blares through the gym. Gym Bro looks up, startled, then around, confused. Other gym members look startled.
scenes.speaker: Gym Bro
scenes.line: Yeh alarm kiska baj raha hai?
scenes.say: ये अलार्म किसका बज रहा है?

scenes.image: Rohan has dropped the dumbbell with a loud clatter, looking surprised and a bit guilty. His hand instinctively goes to his track pant pocket.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Oh no! Yeh toh meri car ki awaaz hai!
scenes.say: ओह नो! ये तो मेरी कार की आवाज़ है!

scenes.image: Close-up on Rohan's hand inside his track pant pocket, accidentally pressing his car key fob. A small red light flashes on the fob, clearly visible.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Meri car ka panic button dab gaya!
scenes.say: मेरी कार का पैनिक बटन दब गया!

scenes.image: Gym Bro points at Rohan, a look of sudden realization and amusement spreading across his face. He's trying not to laugh.
scenes.speaker: Gym Bro

scenes.image: Rohan, totally red-faced with embarrassment, fumbling to turn off the alarm on his fob. Priya is now openly smiling, covering her mouth with her hand to stifle a laugh.
scenes.speaker: Rohan

scenes.image: Priya genuinely laughing, her head thrown back slightly, pointing playfully at Rohan, who is still looking sheepish. She finds the situation endearing.
scenes.speaker: Priya

scenes.image: Rohan looks embarrassed but a tiny, shy smile appears on his face. The car alarm has finally stopped. He's slightly relieved but still red.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Us din Rohan ne muscles nahi, hasi banayi.
scenes.say: उस दिन रोहन ने मसल्स नहीं, हँसी बनाई।

scenes.image: Rohan and Priya are now standing near the water cooler, talking and laughing, looking like they connected over the incident. Rohan looks much more relaxed.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Tumhara first gym day kaisa tha?
scenes.say: तुम्हारा फर्स्ट जिम डे कैसा था?

caption: He tried to lift weights on day 1... 😅
yt_title: He tried to lift weights on day 1... 😅
description: My first gym day turned into an unexpected hilarious disaster! Watch how Rohan tried to impress but failed spectacularly. Has this ever happened to you?
comment_question: Tumhara first gym day kaisa tha?
